about: Project page and coordinator cards: iOS/web/Android parity (board docs/mocks/ios-project-page-and-coordinator-cards/,
owner decisions D2 A and D4 A, gaps G3-G5). One set of cases every client is proved against; a rule change starts here.
`landing`: a criterion's landing half-sentence on the project page, chosen from `landingReason` in the Done card's words
(web `landingReasonLabel`). `expected` is null where no half-sentence is drawn: an unmet criterion shows none.
`landing` (the older three-valued field) is carried as the server sends it, and does not decide the words.
`receiptTime`: a conversation receipt's moment (web `receiptClock`, iOS `OwnerConfirmations.receiptTime`): the short
clock when the moment is today in `timeZone`, else `M/D` then the clock. Read at `now`, in `timeZone`, for `locale`.
en-GB keeps the clock 24-hour, so no AM/PM (whose space differs between platforms) enters the text.
`taskRows`: a project task row's label (web `projectTaskWorkLabel`) and its run-queue row's label (web
`ProjectReadyToRun`; null when the task has no run-queue row in the case), for a stalled running task (`runStalled`)
and tasks set to start by hand (`autoRunWhenReady: false`).
